Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here.AdvertisementColombia and France clash in Maryland on Sunday in an international friendly at Northwest Stadium.Les Bleus battled to a 2-1 win over Brazil on Thursday despite a second-half red card shown to Dayot Upamecano, with Kylian Mbappe on the scoresheet.Colombia were beaten 2-1 by Croatia in their previous game, which ended their unbeaten run that stretched back a full year.
